title: Evaluation of the derivative polynomial
statement: Let $F$ be a real coefficient family on subsets of $[n]$ and let $i\in[n]$. At every Boolean-cube input, the Walsh-basis evaluation of the coefficient family formed from the Fourier coefficients of the Boolean-cube derivative of $F$ equals that discrete derivative.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real coefficient family on subsets of $[n]$
replaced: Let $F(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}a_S\prod_{j\in S}x_j$ be a real multilinear polynomial and fix $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. On $\{-1,1\}^n$, evaluation of its coordinate derivative polynomial equals the discrete derivative of the cube function $F$, where the discrete derivative at $i$ is $\tfrac12(F|_{x_i=1}-F|_{x_i=-1})$.
